A dependable bird who keeps the flock together and plays by the rules.
This bird never suffers in silence. If they're hungry or something isn't right, they file a complaint at full volume, loud enough for the whole street, and expect it fixed now. Their likes and dislikes are just as clear: a treat that doesn't pass the test gets spat straight onto the floor.
An action-loving bird who dives headfirst into anything new.
집안 곳곳을 아슬아슬하게 비행하며 곡예를 부리는 우리 집 탑건! 태어나서: The Top Gun of your house, pulling stunts and near misses in every room! This bird was born without fear and will charge straight at a delivery box or a vacuum cleaner they've never seen before. Their way of investigating anything is to taste it first and then rip it open.
A caring bird who checks on the family and stays close.
집안에서 일어나는 모든 일은 내 컨펌을 받아야 해! 가족들이 모여서 심각: Nothing happens in this house without my sign-off! Whether the family is having a serious talk or just laughing, this bird has to land right in the middle and join in with a flood of alien chatter. When a package arrives, they inspect it before anyone else does. An adorable busybody of the highest rank.
A born entertainer who loves attention and lifts the mood.
\"나를 주모오오옥!\" 가족들의 시선이 자기한테 쏠려있지 않으면 입에: "All eyes on MEEEE!" A born celebrity who gets twitchy the moment the family looks away. To win the attention back they sing nonstop at unhinged energy levels or bust out fancy footwork until somebody reacts. Officially the biggest attention hog in the house.
A determined bird who goes all in once they have a goal.
내가 바로 이 구역의 지배자! 집사를 그저 밥 대령하는 '두 발 달린 비: I run this place! To this bird you're just a two-legged assistant who brings the food. If something isn't to their liking, you get summoned at once with an ear-splitting shout. You aren't training your parrot. Your parrot has you perfectly trained (a.k.a. gaslit).
A curious bird always dreaming up their next prank.
집사의 킹받는 반응을 가장 즐기는 도파민 중독자. 노트북 키보드 자판만: A dopamine addict whose favorite thing is watching you lose it. This clear-eyed maniac picks the keys off your laptop one by one, runs off and looks back at you like 'and what are you gonna do about it?' Yell "No!" and they hear praise and get even happier. An attention seeker who takes trolling seriously, and somehow you can't stay mad.
A warm bird who brings everyone together.
\"어? 손님 오셨네? 안녕! 반가워!\" 처음 보는 배달 기사님에게도: "Oh, a visitor! Hi! Nice to meet you!" The official social butterfly of the house, happy to greet a delivery driver they've never met. They love people so much that they can't stand seeing anyone in the family sit alone. When the room goes quiet, this sweetheart is the first to start chattering and bring the mood back up.
A bird who explores the world with eyes full of curiosity.
눈 뜬 순간부터 잘 때까지 텐션 200%! 온 집안을 헤집고 다니며 쉴: 200% energy from the second their eyes open until bedtime! This bird is the household's daily vitamin, tearing through every room and chattering the entire time. When the mood is really good they throw a one-bird dance party, with furious headbanging and beatboxing nobody can identify. Sitting still is the hardest thing in the world for them.
A calm bird who faithfully follows their familiar routine.
밥 먹는 시간, 불 끄고 자는 시간이 1분이라도 틀어지면 절대 못 참는: The strictest traditionalist in the parrot world. If dinner or lights-out runs even a minute late, they will not have it. Swap their usual treat or move something in the cage by half an inch and this perfectionist sulks all day, giving you a look that says "What is the meaning of this?"
An independent bird who digs into problems and figures them out.
자기 부리의 한계를 시험하는 걸 가장 즐기는 파괴의 신! 비싼 장난감부터: A god of destruction whose favorite hobby is testing what that beak can do! Expensive toys, your precious phone charger cable, perfectly good wallpaper: this deconstruction artist won't rest until everything in sight is in pieces. They're usually quiet, but if it gets too quiet, they are 100% wrecking something big somewhere.
A gentle bird who quietly stays by your side.
집사의 어깨나 정수리가 세상에서 제일 편안한 마약 방석입니다. 화장실 갈: Your shoulder or the top of your head is the comfiest cushion in the world. They have to follow you everywhere, even to the bathroom door. Then they puff their feathers up like a steamed bun and wait quietly with a "go on, pet me~" look. The gentlest sweetheart in the house.
An easygoing bird who moves at their own pace.
\"귀찮게 만지지 마라!\" 억지로 스킨십하는 걸 극혐하며 자기만의 혼자: "Don't touch me, it's annoying!" This bird hates forced cuddles and takes their alone time very seriously. But when they're in a good mood, they'll sidle up, toss you one cool kiss and walk off without looking back. A master of playing hard to get.
A thoughtful bird who steps back and makes a plan.
집사의 생활 패턴을 싹 다 지켜보고 완벽한 타이밍을 노리는 앵무계의 지능: The brains of the parrot world, watching your whole daily routine and waiting for the perfect moment. A closed cage door is a joke to this escape room veteran. They've already mapped out exactly how to act to get the sunflower seeds they want. (Warning: they're already one step ahead of you.)
A reflective bird who gets lost in their own thoughts.
\"이 장난감은 속이 어떻게 생겼지?\" 일단 부리로 다 박살 내고 분해: "What's inside this toy?" A champion of curiosity who has to smash it open and take it apart with their beak to find out. They look like they're zoning out, but there are big thoughts going around in that head. A hipster who goes wilder for your mouse cable or a stray pen cap than for the expensive toys every other bird loves.
An insightful bird who quietly understands your feelings.
집사 기분 파악하는 눈치가 거의 독심술 수준! 집사가 오늘따라 시무룩해: They read your mood so well it's almost mind reading! If you seem down today, they'll quietly come over and rub a cheek against you. A true F. They'd rather stay calmly at your side than zoom around causing trouble, and now and then you'll find this romantic gazing out the window, wistful about something only they know.
A tender-hearted bird who tends a world of their own.
낯선 사람이 오면 일단 깃털부터 잔뜩 부풀리고 \"가까이 오지 마!\"를: A timid one who puffs up every feather when a stranger comes over and goes "Stay back!" But for the one human they've let in, they are endlessly sweet and full of cute tricks: crusty outside, soft inside, by the book. They need their own grubby comfort toy that nobody else would look at twice, or there's no peace of mind.
집사가 외출하려고 현관에서 신발을 신을 때, 우리 앵무새의 반응은?: You're putting on your shoes to head out. How does your parrot react?
새장 창살에 매달려 애절하게 짹짹거리며 분리불안 난리가 난다: Clings to the cage bars, chirping pitifully in a full separation-anxiety meltdown.
\"어디 가!! 나도 데려가!!\" 새장 창살에 매달려 애절하게 짹짹거리: "Where are you going?! Take me!" Clings to the cage bars, chirping pitifully in a full separation-anxiety meltdown.
쳐다도 안 보고 평온하게 제 깃털을 고르거나 밥을 먹는다: Doesn't even look up. Calmly goes on preening or eating.
\"올 때 해바라기씨나 사 와라.\" 쳐다도 안 보고 평온하게 제 깃털을: "Bring back sunflower seeds." Doesn't even look up. Calmly goes on preening or eating.
집사가 다가가 조심스럽게 머리 '긁긁(스킨십)'을 시도하면?: You gently reach over for some head scratches. What happens?
기분이 내키면 냅다 고개부터 들이밀며 무한 쓰담을 요구하는 애교쟁이: A charmer who shoves their head at you the moment the mood strikes and demands endless pets.
기분이 내키면 냅다 고개부터 들이밀며 \"더 긁어라 닝겐\" 무한 쓰담을: "More scritches, human." A charmer who shoves their head at you the moment the mood strikes and demands endless pets.
기분이 아니면 가차 없이 부리로 콱! 피의 응징(입질)을 내리는 까칠보스: A prickly boss. Catch them in the wrong mood and the beak delivers swift, bloody justice.
\"어딜 함부로 만져!\" 기분이 아니면 가차 없이 부리로 콱! 피의 응: "Who said you could touch me?!" A prickly boss. Catch them in the wrong mood and the beak delivers swift, bloody justice.
집사가 폰을 들여다보며 자기한테 집중하지 않을 때?: You're looking at your phone instead of your parrot. What do they do?
화면 앞을 가로막고 손에 찰싹 붙어 온몸으로 방해하는 관종: An attention hog who blocks the screen, sticks to your hand and gets in the way with their whole body.
\"나랑 놀라고!!!\" 화면 앞을 가로막고 손에 찰싹 붙어 온몸으로 방: "Play with me!!!" An attention hog who blocks the screen, sticks to your hand and gets in the way with their whole body.
멀찍이서 제 장난감 갖고 놀거나 혼자 낮잠을 청한다: Plays with a toy at a distance or settles in for a nap alone.
\"바쁘냐? 그럼 난 잔다.\" 멀찍이서 제 장난감 갖고 놀거나 혼자 낮: "Busy? Fine, I'll nap." Plays with a toy at a distance or settles in for a nap alone.
방 안에서 한 곳에서 다른 곳으로 이동할 때 우리 앵무새의 주특기는?: How does your parrot usually get from one side of the room to the other?
무조건 날개를 쫙 펴고 방 안을 가로지르는 날렵한 '탑건' 스타일: Top Gun style: wings out, straight across the room, every single time.
슝~ 푸드덕! 무조건 날개를 쫙 펴고 방 안을 가로지르는 날렵한 '탑건': Whoosh! Flap, flap! Top Gun style: wings out, straight across the room, every single time.
두 발로 바닥을 열심히 걸어 다니는 야무진 '뚜벅이' 스타일: The dedicated pedestrian: gets around the floor on two hard-working feet.
뽈뽈뽈… 두 발로 바닥을 열심히 걸어 다니는 야무진 '뚜벅이' 스타일: Pitter-patter… The dedicated pedestrian: gets around the floor on two hard-working feet.
집사가 한눈판 사이, 우리 앵무새가 가장 많이 치는 대형 사고는?: You look away for a moment. What kind of trouble is your parrot most likely to cause?
벽지 뜯기, 책 갉아먹기, 키보드 자판 쏙쏙 뽑기… 눈에 띄는 건 다 분: Peeling wallpaper, chewing books, popping keys off the keyboard… takes apart anything in sight.
The unstoppable destroyer: Peeling wallpaper, chewing books, popping keys off the keyboard… takes apart anything in sight.
얌전히 자기 장난감이랑 놀거나 거울 보며 자기 얼굴을 감상하는 몽상가: A dreamer who plays quietly with their own toy or admires their face in the mirror.
사고는 무슨~ 얌전히 자기 장난감이랑 놀거나 거울 보며 자기 얼굴을 감상: Trouble? Who, me? A dreamer who plays quietly with their own toy or admires their face in the mirror.
싱크대나 화장실에서 콸콸콸~ 물소리가 들릴 때 반응은?: Your parrot hears running water in the sink or bathroom. What happens?
물만 보면 텐션이 올라 냅다 뛰어들어 깃털을 적시는 워터파크 매니아: A water park fanatic who gets hyped at the sight of water and jumps right in, feathers and all.
\"나도 씻을래!!\" 물만 보면 텐션이 올라 냅다 뛰어들어 깃털을 적시: "Bath time! I'm coming!" A water park fanatic who gets hyped at the sight of water and jumps right in, feathers and all.
전용 목욕통을 대령하거나 곱게 분무해 줘야만 우아하게 씻고, 아니면 물: Requires a proper bird bath or a gentle mist. Otherwise, keeps well clear of the splashes.
배도 부르고 집도 조용해진 평화로운 시간, 우리 앵이의 모습은?: Tummy full, house quiet. What does your parrot do with a peaceful moment?
깃털을 찐빵처럼 빵빵하게 부풀리고 한쪽 발을 몸통에 쏙 숨긴 채 휴식 모: Rest mode: puffed up like a steamed bun with one foot tucked into their feathers.
갑자기 새로운 장난감이나 구석을 탐색하러 가거나, 기분 따라 노래·춤·수: Explores a new toy or corner, or starts singing, dancing or chatting as the mood takes them.
우리 앵무새가 가끔 보여주는 '어이없는 쫄보' 모먼트는?: What is your parrot's most ridiculous scaredy-bird moment?
색깔 옷·처음 본 과일·안경 같은 \"대체 저걸 왜 무서워해?\" 싶은: A colorful shirt, an unfamiliar fruit, a pair of glasses… somehow, these are terrifying.
Scared of the strangest things: A colorful shirt, an unfamiliar fruit, a pair of glasses… somehow, these are terrifying.
제 몸집 100배인 강아지·청소기 앞에서도 깡패처럼 덤비는 노빠꾸 전투기: A fighter jet with no reverse gear who picks fights with dogs and vacuum cleaners a hundred times their size.
쫄보? 그게 뭔데. 제 몸집 100배인 강아지·청소기 앞에서도 깡패처럼: Scared? What's that? A fighter jet with no reverse gear who picks fights with dogs and vacuum cleaners a hundred times their size.
빼입은 새 옷 위에 시원하게 '응가'를 발사한 뒤 녀석의 태도는?: Your parrot just pooped on your lovely new outfit. What do they do next?
아무 일 없었다는 듯 당당하게 제 깃털을 고르는 강철 멘탈: Completely unbothered. Goes back to preening like nothing happened.
\"어쩌라고? 치워라 닝겐.\" 아무 일 없었다는 듯 당당하게 제 깃털을: "So? Clean it up, human." Completely unbothered. Goes back to preening like nothing happened.
집사가 소리치니 재밌다고 위아래로 헤드뱅잉하거나 슬쩍 눈치 보며 푸드덕: Finds your yelling hilarious and starts headbanging, or gives you a look and flutters away.
집사가 소리치니 오히려 재밌다고 위아래로 헤드뱅잉하거나 슬쩍 눈치 보며: Well, this is exciting! Finds your yelling hilarious and starts headbanging, or gives you a look and flutters away.
마음에 안 드는 상황(안 꺼내준다, 간식 안 준다)이 닥쳤을 때?: No treats? Not being let out? How does your parrot handle disappointment?
동네가 떠나가라 고래고래 샤우팅하며 악성 민원을 폭주시킨다: Screams loud enough for the whole neighborhood and floods you with angry complaints.
\"당장 문 열어라악!!!\" 동네가 떠나가라 고래고래 샤우팅하며 악성: "OPEN THIS DOOR RIGHT NOW!" Screams loud enough for the whole neighborhood and floods you with angry complaints.
자기만의 외계어로 쉼 없이 혼잣말하며 조용히 삐쳐 불만을 표출: Sulks quietly and delivers a nonstop stream of complaints in their own alien language.
꿍얼꿍얼… 투덜투덜… 자기만의 외계어로 쉼 없이 혼잣말하며 조용히 삐쳐: Mutter, grumble, mutter… Sulks quietly and delivers a nonstop stream of complaints in their own alien language.
집사가 간식 봉지를 부스럭거리는 소리를 냈을 때 텐션은?: You rustle a bag of treats. How excited does your parrot get?
눈이 뒤집혀서 봉지 소리만 나도 이미 날아와 대기 중!: Eyes go wild at the sound of the bag. Already flown over and waiting!
눈이 뒤집혀서 봉지 소리만 나도 이미 날아와 대기 중! 식탐 1티어 뚱짹: Top-tier snack enthusiast: Eyes go wild at the sound of the bag. Already flown over and waiting!
한입 먹어보고 아니면 퉤, 먹는 것보다 노는 게 더 좋은 소식좌: A light eater who takes one bite, spits it out if it's no good and would rather play than eat.
\"오, 그거 뭐야?\" 한입 먹어보고 아니면 퉤, 먹는 것보다 노는 게: "Oh, what's that?" A light eater who takes one bite, spits it out if it's no good and would rather play than eat.
사람들을 놀라게 하는 우리 앵무새의 필살기(개인기)가 있다면?: Does your parrot have a special talent that surprises people?
말을 따라 하거나 빙글 돌기·하이파이브로 관중 앞에서 폼 나게 뽐내는 엔: Copies words, spins or gives high-fives. This entertainer loves showing off for a crowd.
\"안녕! 밥 줘!\" 말을 따라 하거나 빙글 돌기·하이파이브로 관중 앞: "Hello! Feed me!" Copies words, spins or gives high-fives. This entertainer loves showing off for a crowd.
남들 볼 땐 절대 안 하고 혼자 있을 때만 꿍얼꿍얼 연습하는 수줍은 타입: The shy type who never does it in front of people and only mumbles through practice when alone.
남들 볼 땐 절대 안 하고 혼자 있을 때만 꿍얼꿍얼 연습하거나, 존재 자: A cotton ball that breathes: never performs in front of people and only practices alone, or their whole talent is just existing.
우리 앵무새의 아침 기상과 수면 패턴은?: What is your parrot's morning and sleep routine like?
해 뜨자마자 알람시계처럼 우렁차게 울어대는 얼리버드: An early bird who goes off like an alarm clock the moment the sun is up.
해 뜨자마자 \"아침이다!!! 다들 일어나!!!\" 알람시계처럼 우렁차게: "IT'S MORNING! EVERYONE UP!" An early bird who goes off like an alarm clock the moment the sun is up.
암막 천을 걷어줘도 꾸벅꾸벅 졸거나, 집사 기척이 나야 그제야 부스럭대는: Keeps dozing even after the cover comes off, or only stirs when they hear you moving around.
암막 천을 걷어줘도 \"5분만 더…\" 꾸벅꾸벅 졸거나, 집사 기척이 나: "Five more minutes…" Keeps dozing even after the cover comes off, or only stirs when they hear you moving around.
